name: Atlanta Falcons communications
specialties: injuries; transactions; transcripts; press conferences; unofficial depth chart; practice notebooks
handling_note: Source of record for team announcements; team-produced editorial and analysis are not organizationally independent.

name: Will McFadden
specialties: unofficial depth chart; injury and PUP designations; transactions
handling_note: Team-employed; publishes the club's own unofficial depth chart. Treat as official-voice, not independent reporting.

name: Kelsey Conway
specialties: roster moves; transactions; press-conference recaps; video
handling_note: Team-employed; watch for promotional framing and cross-check consequential claims against independent reporting.

name: Tori McElhaney
specialties: feature depth; locker-room access; roster and scheme context
handling_note: Strong reporting pedigree (former The Athletic Falcons beat) but now team-employed; still an official voice, not independent.

name: Josh Kendall
specialties: beat reporting; roster analysis; quarterback room; radio hits
handling_note: Subscription paywall; separate sourced reporting from column-style analysis. Do not reproduce paywalled text.

name: Daniel Flick
specialties: daily beat; camp intel; offensive line and right-tackle coverage
handling_note: Took over the AJC Falcons beat in May 2026 (replaced D. Orlando Ledbetter). Paywall; favor concrete observations over camp evaluations.

name: Marc Raimondi
specialties: camp intel; position battles; roster cuts; quarterback room
handling_note: Primary ESPN Falcons voice since 2024 (replaced Michael Rothstein on the beat). Separate reporting from national-desk speculation.

name: Michael Rothstein
specialties: investigations; off-field and legal stories; occasional Falcons collaborations
handling_note: No longer on the Falcons beat; surfaces on off-field items (e.g., the Pearce suspension). Not a daily camp feed.

name: D. Orlando Ledbetter
specialties: long institutional memory; historical and organizational context
handling_note: Covered the Falcons for AJC for ~22 years; retired from AJC March 2026 and now publishes independently at a lower cadence.

name: NFL communications
specialties: league transactions; suspensions; official announcements; gamebooks
handling_note: League outlet; authoritative on suspensions and official transactions. Retrieve the specific release for consequential items.

name: The Falcoholic
specialties: daily camp notes; unofficial depth-chart breakdowns; position battles
handling_note: Fan-site with consistent daily camp coverage; mixes reporting and opinion. Attribute the individual author and cite original sources.

name: Blogging Dirty
handling_note: Aggregation-heavy; verify claims against primary reporting before use.

name: Pro Football Reference
specialties: historical stats; rosters; snap counts; game logs
handling_note: Canonical stat reference; snap counts identified as unofficial. Not a real-time camp source.

name: Pro Football Focus
specialties: player grades; alignment, route and pressure data; depth-chart projections
handling_note: Proprietary methodology; grades are evaluations, not facts. Paywall.

name: Over the Cap
specialties: contract structure; cap charges; dead money
handling_note: Third-party interpretation of contract data (e.g., Tua and Cousins mechanics); cross-check unusual figures.

name: Spotrac
handling_note: Useful cross-check; not an official transaction or contract filing.
